skill.name: lead-followup-strategist
skill.description: Create a consent-aware, practical follow-up plan for inbound leads and customer enquiries. Produces message drafts, timing, CRM fields and next actions; never sends messages or claims a booking.
skill.summary: Draft consent-aware lead follow-ups with next actions, timing, CRM fields and clear stop conditions.
skill.author: falconprojectai-arch

security_audit.summary: The reconnaissance finding is a false positive: SKILL.md:37 requests human review of jurisdiction-specific privacy and marketing requirements. No evidence found of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or unauthorized actions in the reviewed file. The skill explicitly limits work to drafts and requires respect for consent and opt-outs.

static_findings.snippet: - Avoid legal conclusions. Flag jurisdiction-specific privacy/marketing requirements for human revie

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md:37 says to avoid legal conclusions and flag jurisdiction-specific privacy or marketing requirements for human review. This is a compliance safeguard, with no instruction to inspect systems or collect environment information.

content.value_statement: Inconsistent follow-up can leave genuine customer enquiries unanswered or lead to unwanted contact. This skill drafts practical next actions, messages and schedules that respect consent and stop conditions.
actual_capabilities: Ask for missing business, enquiry, channel, consent, lead status and fulfillment details that materially change the plan.
Summarize lead status and recommend a next action.
Draft brief messages in the customer language and requested channel style.
Suggest conservative follow-up timing with local-time placeholders and a default of one helpful follow-up.
List CRM fields for source, enquiry date, consent, status, last contact, next action and opt-out.
Define stop conditions and identify decisions requiring human review.
limitations: Produces drafts only; it does not send messages, place calls, book appointments, charge cards or update records.
Relies on supplied facts and documented contact permission; it cannot independently verify consent, availability or pricing.
Does not provide legal conclusions about privacy or marketing requirements.
Does not support unsolicited outreach, sensitive-trait targeting or repeated reminders without a customer response or express request.

use_cases.title: Respond to a new service enquiry
use_cases.description: Draft a helpful response and next action for an inbound service request using confirmed availability and channel permission.

use_cases.title: Follow up on an unanswered quote
use_cases.description: Prepare one respectful quote follow-up with a clear next step and a stop condition if the customer does not respond.

use_cases.title: Prepare a CRM handoff
use_cases.description: Summarize an enquiry, list tracking fields and identify consent or fulfillment questions requiring a human decision.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner: Draft a first reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a reply for an inbound [service] enquiry received [date]. Status: new enquiry. Channel: [channel]. Documented permission: [details]. Confirmed constraints: [constraints]. Ask for material missing details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Responding to a new customer enquiry

prompt_templates.title: Intermediate: Follow up on a quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan one follow-up for a quote sent [date] for [service]. Channel: [channel]. Documented contact basis: [details]. Quote terms: [terms]. Include a draft, local-time placeholder and stop conditions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Checking whether a customer needs help with an existing quote

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Review unclear permission
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this anonymized enquiry: [context]. Status: [status]. Channel: [channel]. Consent evidence: [evidence or unknown]. Identify missing facts, appropriate next action, CRM fields and human review needs. Do not invent permission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Deciding whether further contact is appropriate

prompt_templates.title: Advanced: Prepare a multilingual handoff
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a complete follow-up plan for [business] and [enquiry]. Customer language: [language]. Channel: [channel]. Documented basis: [details]. Status: [status]. Verified constraints: [constraints]. Include summary, action, draft, timing, CRM fields, stop conditions and handoff.
prompt_templates.scenario: Preparing a structured plan for a colleague to review

output_examples.input: A cleaning business sent a quote three days ago. The customer explicitly requested one email reminder. The quote remains valid; no reminder has been sent.
output: Status: Quote sent; awaiting customer response.
Next action: Prepare the requested reminder for human approval.
Draft: Hello [Customer], do you have any questions about your cleaning quote? Please reply if you would like to discuss the next step.
Timing: [Local date and time], within the requested reminder window.
CRM fields: Source, enquiry date, documented email permission, quote status, last contact, next action and opt-out.
Stop: No further reminders unless the customer responds or expressly requests them. Honor any opt-out immediately.

output_examples.input: A repair shop has a past customer enquiry. There is no documented permission for marketing follow-up, and staff want to send a promotional message.
output: Next action: Do not draft a marketing follow-up until the business verifies its lawful basis.
Message: No promotional draft provided while permission remains unclear.
Timing: No follow-up scheduled pending review.
CRM fields: Record enquiry source, date, channel and unknown consent status without adding unnecessary personal data.
Handoff: Ask a responsible staff member to review the contact basis and jurisdiction-specific requirements.

best_practices: Provide anonymized enquiry details, lead status, documented channel permission and confirmed business constraints.
Review every draft for accuracy, customer language, opt-outs and a clear next step before authorizing any contact.
Default to one helpful follow-up, record stop conditions and use local-time placeholders until timing is confirmed.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for unsolicited campaigns or treating an enquiry as unlimited permission for marketing.
Adding invented urgency, discounts, availability or previous conversations to pressure a customer.
Providing unnecessary personal data or treating a draft as proof that a message was sent or a booking was made.

faq.question: Does the skill send messages or update my CRM?
faq.answer: No. It drafts messages, plans and CRM field suggestions. A human or separately authorized system must approve sending and perform any record changes.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide business type, enquiry details and date, channel permission, lead status and real constraints. Use placeholders instead of unnecessary personal data.

faq.question: What happens when consent is unclear?
faq.answer: It recommends no marketing follow-up and asks the business to verify its lawful basis before proceeding.

faq.question: How many follow-ups does it recommend?
faq.answer: The default is one helpful follow-up, then stop unless the customer responds or expressly requests reminders.

faq.question: Can it draft in another language?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions call for the customer language and requested channel style. Review wording and local context before use.

faq.question: Does it determine whether outreach is legally compliant?
faq.answer: No. It avoids legal conclusions and flags jurisdiction-specific privacy or marketing requirements for human review.
